approach: Static recompilation with 3dsrecomp, run on the Zakuro 3DS runtime; the launcher builds it out of the player's own copy
notes: 3D at up to 8 times the console's resolution, battles and cutscenes at 60 FPS with frame interpolation, a 16:9 mode, play on the top screen alone with the bottom screen on demand, a Three Houses style battle display, and feet for every character model. Original mode plays the game as the console does.
